description: Parity: the panel fits Settings' content. With the 10 adapters of fixtures/adapters.json (3 rows of 4), the last adapter switch lies inside the window, also while the reset confirmation adds its row, and the window stays on its display.
requirement: P2-settings-fit (GPUI Phase 2b parity, Tauri ee80e70:desktop/src/main.rs resize_panel + dist/panel.js fitWindow)
notes: The a11y dump carries no bounds, so the view reports measured layout (views/layout.rs): view.layout.last_adapter is the last switch's bounds and view.layout.viewport the window's content size, both in window points from the same frame. A {"path": ...} operand compares the two (README, Expectations).
Tauri fitted the window to its content (clamped 96..900, capped to the display's work area, moved up rather than off the bottom). At a fixed 640x140 the grid is clipped after its first row.
Fails on the instrumentation commit (before the fix) at 'shown: the last adapter switch is inside the window'.
